steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction: Make all required DMEM‑based media according to the recipes below, using sterile technique and the listed reagents.

substeps.instruction: Complete media (DMEM‑GHAA‑10% FBS, 500 mL): 429 mL DMEM, 50 mL 100 % FBS, 10 mL 1 M HEPES (pH 7.2‑7.5), 1 mL 10 000 U/mL Pen‑Strep, 5 mL 100× MEM non‑essential amino acids, 5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine. Adjust to 500 mL.
DMEM‑GHAA‑5% FBS (500 mL): 454 mL DMEM, 25 mL 100 % FBS, 10 mL 1 M HEPES, 5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine, 1 mL Pen‑Strep, 5 mL MEM‑NEAA. Adjust to 500 mL.
Infection media (DMEM‑GHAA + 0.2 % BSA, 50 mL): 46.9 mL DMEM, 0.5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine, 1 mL 1 M HEPES, 0.1 mL Pen‑Strep, 0.5 mL MEM‑NEAA, 1 mL 10 % BSA. Adjust to 50 mL.
DMEM‑GH‑2% FBS (500 mL): 475 mL DMEM, 10 mL 100 % FBS, 10 mL 1 M HEPES, 5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine. Adjust to 500 mL.
DMEM‑GH (500 mL): 485 mL DMEM, 5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine, 10 mL 1 M HEPES. Adjust to 500 mL.
Transfection media (15 mL): 15 mL OptiMEM, 15 µL RNaseOUT (40 U/mL). Adjust to 15 mL.
Serum‑free media (DMEM‑GHAA, 500 mL): 479 mL DMEM, 10 mL 1 M HEPES, 1 mL Pen‑Strep, 5 mL MEM‑NEAA, 5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine. Adjust to 500 mL.
VPSF‑GHAA media (50 mL): 47.9 mL VP‑SFM, 1 mL 1 M HEPES, 0.1 mL Pen‑Strep, 0.5 mL MEM‑NEAA, 0.5 mL 200 mM L‑glutamine. Adjust to 50 mL.

steps.title: Prepare auxiliary solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following buffers and solutions as described; store at the temperatures indicated.

substeps.instruction: 2× PHEM buffer (500 mL): dissolve 72.56 g PIPES, 23.84 g HEPES, 15.2 g EGTA, 1 mL 2 M MgCl₂ (to give 4 mM final) in ~400 mL water, adjust pH to 7.2 with 5 M NaOH, bring to 500 mL.
2× loading buffer + β‑ME (10 mL): 1.25 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 6.8, 4 mL 10 % SDS, 0.4 mL 1 % bromophenol blue, 2 mL 100 % glycerol, 1 mL 10 % β‑mercaptoethanol, add water to 10 mL.
0.08 % Trypsin‑EDTA: mix 2.5 mL 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA with 7.5 mL PBS.
1 % Perasafe: dissolve 1 g Perasafe powder in 100 mL water.
5 % Chemgene: add 50 mL Chemgene to 1 L water.
0.1 % PBST: add 1 mL Tween‑20 to 1 L PBS.

steps.title: Design consensus primers
steps.instruction: Design the following primers using the 5′ and 3′ terminal consensus sequences of MLB1 and MLB2:

substeps.instruction: MLB1 forward: GAGTAATACGACTCACTATAGCCAAGAGTGGTGGTATGGCTG
MLB1 reverse: CCATACATTTATGCTGGAAGAAAAAAAGC
MLB2 forward: GAGTAATACGACTCACTATAGCCAAGAGTGGTAGGATGGCTGTG
MLB2 reverse: CCTCTAAATCTACCTGATTAGAAAAAAAAAGATAAAATTTTATTTGTC

steps.title: Extract viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic RNA from the clinical isolates (MLB1 MK089434, MLB2 MK089435) with AVL lysis buffer and Zymo‑Spin RNA columns, elute in 30 µL RNase‑free water and quantify on a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Synthesize first‑strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription using 11 µL viral RNA (25‑100 ng) with Superscript III as follows.

substeps.instruction: Mix 11 µL RNA, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 1 µL 100 µM virus‑specific reverse primer (total 13 µL).
Incubate 65 °C 5 min, then place on ice (4 °C).
Add 7 µL RT mix (4 µL 5× first‑strand buffer, 1 µL 100 mM DTT, 1 µL RNaseOUT, 1 µL Superscript III).
Incubate 55 °C 60 min, then 70 °C 15 min, hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Amplify full‑length genomes
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify MLB1 and MLB2 genomes with Phusion High‑Fidelity polymerase using the virus‑specific primers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50 µL reaction: 1 µL cDNA (25‑100 ng), 10 µL 5× HF buffer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 0.3 µL 100 µM forward primer, 0.3 µL 100 µM reverse primer, 0.5 µL Phusion polymerase, 1 µL DMSO, 36 µL water.
Thermocycler: 98 °C 1 min; 35 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 57 °C 10 s, 72 °C 3 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 10 °C.

steps.title: Purify and verify PCR product
steps.instruction: Run the 0.7 % agarose gel, excise the correct band, purify with Zymo column, and sequence with specific primers.

steps.title: Clone genomes into pAVIC
steps.instruction: Insert the purified MLB1 or MLB2 genome into pAVIC by single‑step ligation‑independent cloning, replacing the HAstV1 genome under the T7 promoter.

steps.title: Transform and isolate plasmids
steps.instruction: Transform XL1‑Blue competent cells with the ligation product, select single colonies, grow overnight cultures, and purify plasmid DNA with the QIAGEN Plasmid Plus Midi kit.

steps.title: Linearize RG plasmids
steps.instruction: Digest each plasmid (MLB1, MLB2, and GNN controls) with XhoI as follows.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL plasmid (1 µg/µL), 1 µL XhoI (10 U/µL), 5 µL 10× FD buffer, 39 µL Milli‑Q water (total 50 µL).
Incubate 37 °C 2 h.
Purify linear DNA with a PCR Clean‑Up kit, elute in 20 µL nuclease‑free water, quantify on a Nanodrop.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcribe T7 RNA
steps.instruction: Generate capped T7 RNA transcripts from each linearized plasmid using the mMESSAGE mMACHINE kit.

substeps.instruction: Combine 3 µL linear plasmid (150‑400 ng), 5 µL 2× NTP/CAP, 1 µL 10× transcription buffer, 1 µL T7 enzyme mix (total 10 µL).
Incubate 37 °C 1 h (no DNase I treatment).
Check 0.5 µL of reaction on a 1 % agarose gel.
Store RNA at –70 °C or use immediately for electroporation.

steps.title: Prepare Huh7.5.1 cells for electroporation
steps.instruction: Harvest cells at 80‑90 % confluence and resuspend for electroporation.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑chill electroporation cuvettes (4 °C).
Warm complete media and 0.08 % Trypsin‑EDTA to 37 °C.
Remove media, rinse flask with 10 mL PBS, add 15 mL PBS, incubate 3‑5 min.
Add 5 mL 0.08 % Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate RT 2‑3 min.
Neutralize with 10 mL complete media, collect cells in 50 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge 400 × g 5 min (no brake), discard supernatant.
Wash pellet with 45 mL PBS, repeat centrifugation, count cells.
Resuspend ~5 × 10⁵ cells in 800 µL PBS per electroporation.

steps.title: Electroporate T7 RNA into cells
steps.instruction: Introduce viral RNA into Huh7.5.1 cells using a Bio‑Rad Gene Pulser Xcell.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µL cell suspension + 10 µL (~20 µg) T7 RNA to a 4 mm cuvette.
Set exponential mode: 800 V, 25 µF, 0.3‑0.5 ms time constant; pulse twice, tapping cuvette between pulses.
Immediately add 500 µL DMEM‑GHAA‑5 % FBS media, mix, transfer to a 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge 400 × g 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 mL fresh DMEM‑GHAA‑5 % FBS.
Seed 1 mL per well into a 6‑well plate.
After 3‑5 h replace media with 1.2 mL DMEM‑GHAA‑5 % FBS to remove dead cells.
At 24 h wash with 1 mL PBS, then add 1.2 mL VPSF‑GHAA media.
Incubate 24 h for MLB2 or 48‑72 h for MLB1 before harvest.

steps.title: Harvest and clarify virus stocks
steps.instruction: Collect supernatants and cells, clarify, filter, and store as passage‑0 virus.

substeps.instruction: Freeze plates at –70 °C ≥1 h, thaw RT, collect cells and supernatant into 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge 7,000 × g 5 min, filter supernatant through 0.2 µm filter.
Add glycerol to 5 % (v/v) and BSA to 0.2 % (w/v).
Aliquot and label as P0.

steps.title: Generate higher‑passage stocks
steps.instruction: Infect fresh Huh7.5.1 cells with P0 virus at MOI 0.1 and repeat harvest to obtain P1, P2, etc.

steps.title: Titrate virus by immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Determine infectious units per mL using a 96‑well plate assay.

substeps.instruction: Seed 2.5‑3 × 10⁴ Huh7.5.1 cells per well in a flat‑bottom 96‑well plate 24 h before infection (80‑90 % confluence).
Prepare 10‑fold serial dilutions of virus in infection media (135 µL media + 15 µL virus per well).
Remove culture media, add 100 µL each dilution to wells (start with lowest dilution).
Incubate 20‑28 h (MLB2) or 40‑48 h (MLB1) at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Remove inoculum, inactivate waste with 10 % chloros (sodium hypochlorite).
Fix cells with 100 µL 4 % PFA in PBS for 20‑30 min RT; disinfect plate lid with 4 % PFA.
Wash 1‑2× with PBS (100‑200 µL), optionally store at 4 °C.
Permeabilize 10 min with 1 % Triton‑X‑100 in PBS.
Wash 2× PBS, block with 4 % milk in PBS 1 h RT.
Add 45 µL primary antibody (anti‑MLB1 capsid, 1:300 in antibody solution) per well, incubate 1‑2 h RT or overnight 4 °C.
Wash 3× 200 µL PBS (5 min each).
Add 45 µL secondary antibody (IRDye 800 anti‑rabbit, 1:3,000) per well, incubate 1‑2 h RT.
Wash 3× PBS, add 100 µL PBS, clean bottom with 70 % ethanol.
Scan plate on LICOR imager (+3 mm offset, medium, 84 µm), export 300 dpi image.
Count capsid‑positive cells in the lowest dilution and calculate IU/mL = (positive cells/0.01) × 1,000.

steps.title: Measure replication kinetics by western blot
steps.instruction: Collect infected cells at defined times and detect capsid protein.

substeps.instruction: Seed 2.5 × 10⁵ Huh7.5.1 cells per well in a 6‑well plate 24 h before infection (60‑75 % confluence).
Wash once with 1 mL DMEM‑GHAA, infect with 250 µL DMEM‑GHAA containing MLB1 or MLB2 at MOI 1, incubate 1‑2 h RT on rocker.
Add 1 mL DMEM‑GHAA‑5 % FBS, move plates to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
At 24, 48, 72, 96 h post‑infection, collect cells and supernatant into 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge 2,000 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 80 µL 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 6.8, add 85 µL 2× LB‑βME.
Boil 95 °C 5 min, spin 9,600 × g 1 min.
Load 10 µL per lane on 8‑12 % SDS‑PAGE, run 120 V 1 h.
Transfer to 0.2 µm nitrocellulose (25 V, 1 A, 30 min, semi‑dry).
Block 4 % milk in PBS 1 h RT.
Incubate with anti‑MLB1 capsid (1:3,000) and anti‑tubulin (1:1,000) 1 h RT or overnight 4 °C.
Wash 3× 0.1 % PBST 5 min each.
Incubate with IRDye 800 anti‑rabbit and IRDye 680 anti‑mouse (both 1:3,000) 1 h RT or overnight 4 °C.
Wash 3× PBST, scan on LI‑COR ODYSSEY CLx, analyze with Image Studio v5.2.

steps.title: Detect infection by immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Stain infected cells on chamber slides or coverslips for capsid and dsRNA.

substeps.instruction: Day 1: Seed 5 × 10⁴ Huh7.5.1 cells per well on IBIDI 8‑well chamber slides (or 1 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 12‑well plate).
Day 2: Wash with 1 mL DMEM‑GHAA, infect with 250 µL DMEM‑GHAA containing virus at MOI 0.1 (include mock well).
Incubate 1‑2 h RT on rocker, then add 300 µL DMEM‑GHAA‑5 % FBS, move to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Fix at 24, 48, 72 h post‑infection with 10 % formaldehyde in PHEM (1:1) for 15 min (or 4 % PFA in PBS).
Wash 3× PBS, store at 4 °C or proceed.
Permeabilize 10 min with 0.1 % Triton‑X‑100 in PBS.
Wash 3× PBS, block 1 h RT with 2 % goat serum in PBS.
Add primary antibodies: anti‑MLB1 capsid (1:300) and anti‑dsRNA J2 (1:250) in antibody solution, incubate 1 h RT or overnight 4 °C.
Wash 3× PBS, add secondary antibodies: anti‑rabbit Alexa 488 and anti‑mouse Alexa 594 (1:1,000), incubate 1 h RT or overnight 4 °C.
Wash 3× PBS, add Hoechst 1:12,000 in PBS 5 min RT, replace with PBS.
Image with Leica SP5 confocal (63× water‑immersion) or equivalent.

steps.title: Construct MLB replicon plasmids
steps.instruction: Generate MLB1 and MLB2 replicon constructs by retaining the genome up to ORFX, inserting a foot‑and‑mouth disease 2A sequence followed by Renilla luciferase, a stop codon, the final 624 nt of the genome and a 35‑nt poly‑A tail.

steps.title: Linearize replicon plasmids
steps.instruction: Digest pMLB1R, pMLB2R, and their GNN controls with XhoI, purify, and quantify as described for RG plasmids.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcribe replicon RNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize capped replicon RNAs using the mMESSAGE mMACHINE kit.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1.5 µL linear plasmid (100‑200 ng), 2.5 µL 2× NTP/CAP, 0.5 µL 10× transcription buffer, 0.5 µL T7 enzyme (total 5 µL).
Incubate 37 °C 60‑90 min.
Add 2 U DNase I, incubate RT 20 min.
Check 1 % agarose gel, purify with RNA Clean‑Up kit, elute, adjust to 100‑200 ng/µL.

steps.title: Transfect replicon RNA into cells
steps.instruction: Introduce replicon RNAs into Huh7.5.1 cells using Lipofectamine 2000.

substeps.instruction: Grow cells to 70‑90 % confluence in a T175 flask.
Wash with 10 mL PBS, trypsinize with 2‑3 mL 0.08 % Trypsin‑EDTA (RT 2‑3 min), neutralize with 10 mL DMEM‑GH‑2 % FBS, collect in 50 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge 400 × g 5 min (no brake), discard supernatant, resuspend in 25 mL DMEM‑GH, centrifuge again, discard, resuspend in DMEM‑GH to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Prepare transfection mix in OptiMEM + RNaseOUT (40 U/mL): for each sample add 0.5 µL Lipofectamine 2000 and 0.5 µL OptiMEM (add 10 % extra for pipetting loss). Incubate 5 min RT.
In a second tube add 100 ng total RNA (90 ng replicon + 10 ng firefly control) in 10 µL OptiMEM.
Combine mixes, incubate 20 min RT.
Add 100 µL cell suspension (1 × 10⁵ cells) to transfection mix, incubate 2‑3 min RT, add FBS to 5 % final, transfer to a flat‑bottom 96‑well plate.
Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Luciferase reporter assay
steps.instruction: Measure firefly and Renilla luciferase activities from replicon‑transfected cells.

substeps.instruction: At 4, 20, 24, and 30 h post‑transfection discard media, add 100 µL 1× passive lysis buffer per well, freeze plates –70 °C ≥30 min, then thaw RT 30 min.
Transfer 20 µL lysate to a luminometer plate, add 20 µL Luciferase Assay Reagent II, read firefly luminescence on a GloMax Navigator.
Add 20 µL 1× Stop & Glo reagent, incubate 10 min in the dark, read Renilla luminescence.
Calculate replicon activity = (Renilla signal / Firefly signal) after subtracting mock background.

description: Validation of protocol The reproducibility of the protocol has been described in the following research articles: • Ali et al. [1]. Attenuation hotspots in neurotropic human astroviruses. Plos Biology . • Ali et al. [2] The astrovirus N-terminal nonstructural protein anchors replication complexes to the perinuclear ER membranes. Plos Pathogens .
